claims.statement: Communities before the kingdom of Kerma: approximately 3500–2500 BCE.
Pre-Kerma settlement included a large enclosure, interpreted as protection for people and wealth. Evidence for wider Upper Nubian connections remains limited.

evidence.locator: Pre-Kerma settlement; The kingdom of Kerma
evidence.note: Broad Pre-Kerma phase. The site evidence does not establish a single state throughout Upper Nubia.
